name: Kestrel Drift
subtitle: Deterministic Drone Physics & Positioning Simulator
description: A deterministic, fixed-timestep drone simulator built from scratch to model positioning stability, inertia, gusty wind disturbance, and payload ballistics.

details.intro: Kestrel Drift is a custom-built drone simulation project focused on realistic control authority, altitude hold, gust modeling, and payload drop validation. The entire physics stack is implemented without external engines, using a force-based motion model and a fully deterministic update loop.
highlights: Custom quadrotor flight model (angle-mode pitch/roll + altitude hold)
Deterministic gusty wind system (seed-based, overlapping envelopes)
Motor response, inertia and thrust compensation under tilt
Independent payload physics with quadratic drag and ballistic validation presets
Strict simulation/render separation (WorldState as single source of truth)
tech: Custom math utilities (vec2 / vec3 / deterministic RNG)
Action-based input binding system with runtime rebinding
